meta_desc: Deepmosaic is a Windows desktop app that uses AI to automatically detect targets in your videos and apply mosaic. It automates the mosaic work you now do by hand. It cannot remove existing mosaic. It detects male and female body areas, human faces, and the position of existing mosaic (it applies mosaic over it again). All processing stays on your PC, and your footage is never sent outside it. The detected mosaic information can be imported into Adobe Premiere Pro.
main_phrase: Take video editing to the next level with AI
card_image_description: If the uploaded file has areas that need correction, it is shown here after mosaic is applied.
payload_too_large: You can upload files of up to {} MB.
invalid_parameter_invalid: Only PNG and JPEG files can be uploaded.
deep_learning_desc: Deep learning is used to automatically detect body areas. It learns the features of body areas from a wide range of sample data and automatically detects body areas in images it has never seen.
find_desc: Automatically detects male and female body areas and applies mosaic. You can automate the tedious correction work on adult content. Tools for editing the detected areas are also included.
precision_desc: For services that handle images and videos, monitoring adult content is a challenge. By automating content monitoring that is too much to handle by hand, we contribute to an internet that everyone can use safely.
title_index: Automating video mosaic processing with AI
seo_brand_suffix: Deepmosaic - AI software that applies mosaic to videos
